name: RA_RECURRING_BILL_PLAN_LINES
description: This table contains the changes to a recurring bill plan, such as the amount to credit, quantity to credit, override amount, override quantity, and effective date.

columns.name: RECURRING_BILL_PLAN_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the recurring bill plan line.

columns.name: RECURRING_BILL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the recurring bill plan.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Effective date of the changes described in the recurring bill plan line.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number that indicates the first period with an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and others.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the first override period.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Override amount for the period indicated in the first override period.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number that indicates the second period with an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and others.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the second override period.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Override amount for the period indicated in the second override period.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number that indicates the third period with an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and others.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the third override period.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Override amount for the period indicated in the third override period.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number that indicates the fourth period with an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and others.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the fourth override period.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Override amount for the period indicated in the fourth override period.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number that indicates the fifth period with an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and others.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the fifth override period.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Override amount for the period indicated in the fifth override period.

columns.name: AMOUNT_TO_CREDIT
columns.description: Amount to credit in a full recurring period.

columns.name: QUANTITY_TO_CREDIT
columns.description: Quantity to credit in a full recurring period.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE_REDUCTION
columns.description: Reduction in the unit selling price for a full recurring period.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Either the original item amount on the contract or the new item amount after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Either the original item quantity on the contract or the new item quantity after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_UNITPRICE
columns.description: Either the original item unit price on the contract or the new item unit price after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
